requirements.title: Position descriptors set the next character position and nondefault skipped characters can be processor dependent
requirements.definition: T, TL, TR, and X specify the position of the next transmitted character; if skipped characters are nondefault character in the stated file contexts, the result is processor dependent latitude.

pending.nondefault-skipped-processor-dependent: Permission/source-control: no portable fixture is filed because the result is processor dependent; future tests must not require one result for skipped nondefault characters in the stated file contexts.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans use independent literal expected strings or scalar sentinels. Negative plans change one property from a conforming control and attribute the violation to this unit only.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Pending output plans use internal WRITE to a CHARACTER variable and name exact expected characters including blanks when the unit is internally testable. Unnumbered prose restrictions are not promoted to numbered-constraint diagnostics. Where the source makes a behavior processor dependent, or where a rule requires external stream/direct/sequential files or unregistered defined I/O, the pending plan is explicitly source-control or unassertable rather than a fixture oracle. The nondefault skipped-character result is explicitly processor dependent and unassertable. This mixed unit is split: p1.position-obligation carries the mandatory next-character positioning rule, and p1.nondefault-skipped-latitude carries the processor-dependent result as permission.

requirements.title: Input positioning before the current position can reprocess record portions
requirements.definition: On input, positioning before the current position can cause portions of a record to be processed more than once, possibly with different editing.

pending.input-backward-reprocesses: READ('12','(I1,TL1,I1)') into two integers; expect first=1 and second=1, because TL1 positions the second I1 to reprocess the first character.

requirements.title: Input may position beyond the record if no characters are transmitted there
requirements.definition: On input, a position beyond the last character of the record may be specified if no characters are transmitted from those positions.

pending.input-beyond-end-no-transmission-permitt: READ('7','(I1,T3)') into one integer; expect 7 and no error because no descriptor transmits from position 3.
pending.input-beyond-end-transmission-unassertab: Do not create a negative that reads from beyond the record under this unit; the unit only grants permission when no characters are transmitted.

requirements.title: Output position descriptors do not transmit by themselves and skipped unfilled positions become blanks on later output
requirements.definition: On output, position descriptors do not by themselves transmit characters or affect record length; if later output reaches or follows the specified position, skipped unfilled positions are blank as if the record were initially blank-filled.

pending.position-alone-no-transmission: WRITE(buf,'(T3)') into character(len=3); expect exactly '   ', showing no descriptor-transmitted character.

requirements.definition: Output characters can be replaced; the position edit descriptor itself never directly replaces, but subsequent editing after repositioning can replace.
